name: latency-guard-v1
status: prospective follow-up to an observed v1 failure; not an original preregistered hypothesis
question: Can simple execution-time temporal filters reduce delay failures of a frozen BC256 policy without retraining?
secondary_constraints: Report clean-condition difference and successful episode length; do not hide loss of speed or clean success.
coefficient_selection: 0.5 fixed as a simple dyadic baseline before new test results; no coefficient sweep or post-test tuning
selection_caveat: BC256 was chosen after observing its latency sensitivity in study v1; new scenario seeds prevent reusing the same evaluation cases but do not erase model-family selection bias.
claims: Engineering baseline and controlled intervention, not a novel smoothing algorithm or real-robot result.
